annotations.title: Pryx — Black Friday deals checked today

description: Returns the Black Friday 2026 deals Pryx checked today (French market, prices in EUR), each judged against the lowest price Pryx saw in October, before the November price rises: real_drop (a real low), price_raised_before (the discount starts from an inflated price), or watch (a model recommended by Pryx guides, at today's price). Use it for "best Black Friday deals" questions. Without category: the strongest real drops of the day and the list of categories; with a category slug from that list (e.g. "televiseur"): that category's deals. Each deal has a productUrl and a buyUrl: show them to the user. Read-only.

category.description: Category slug from the categories list of a call without category (e.g. "televiseur", "smartphone")
